content: Review findings (bot or human) against files under .claude/skills/<skill>/ are fixed UPSTREAM at the origin repo and pulled back on the next re-vendor — never patched locally. Established while triaging PR #30 (ask-colleague re-vendor from colleague 1.63.0), where all 8 Qodo findings landed on byte-verbatim vendored files. A local patch is silently reverted by the next /mass-update and breaks `diff -r` against the origin as a verification check. Practical triage recipe: (1) prove verbatim-ness with `diff -r ../<origin>/.claude/skills/<s> .claude/skills/<s>` before arguing, (2) verify each finding against the upstream tree so the pushback is specific rather than blanket, (3) file the accurate ones as one consolidated upstream issue, (4) still fix the first-party gaps the review surfaced next door — for PR #30 that was the docs/skill-sources.md ledger row and the missing version bump. Also note: bot line-length findings on .sh files are false positives here — the 100-char rule is flake8/black/isort, Python-only.

devex CLI verbs in culture-agent-template need an explicit `--agent claude-code` flag. The repo's culture.yaml declares `backend: colleague` (a valid Culture backend that fixes the resident prompt to AGENTS.colleague.md), but devex only accepts claude|codex|copilot|acp and hard-errors 'unknown backend colleague' before doing any work. Hit on `devex pr reply 30`. Applies to every devex pr verb driven through the cicd skill here. Fix is the flag, not editing culture.yaml — the colleague backend declaration is load-bearing for steward doctor's backend-consistency invariant.
